text:
do not undress my love

you might find a mannequin:

do not undress the mannequin

you might find

my love.


long ago she

forgot me.


she is trying on a new

hat

and looks more

coquettish

than ever.


she is a child

and a mannequin

and death.


I cannot hate

that


she did

nothing

out of the ordinary.


I only wanted

her to.

translation.title: Trapped
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the mannequin/love/death substitutions and the bitter final expectation.
